items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: And Bess (?) would get to the piano and play and I would sing.

ctx.x: I was too young, I was too young in those days, I didn't know how to do -- I didn't know (unintelligible). I was too young to go in them clubs (unintelligible). They wouldn't let me go in places. After it got to be (unintelligible), I knew a lot of people here. I knew a lot of girls here, (Unintelligible). I used to play the (unintelligible). (Laughter.)
And all they wanted to know, could you play the piano and sing? And Bess (?) would get to the piano and play and I would sing. And they let us in there. (Unintelligible).
Do you remember when that was?
